feeds.title: Episcopal News Service
feeds.description: Episcopal News Service (ENS) offers in-depth reporting and analysis of local, regional, national and international news for Episcopalians and others interested in the church's mission and ministry. Providing written and multimedia coverage, ENS is the officially sponsored online news source of the Episcopal Church.

feeds.title: Episcopal Migration Ministries Blog
feeds.description: The latest news from Episcopal Migration Ministries about refugee resettlement efforts in the United States. Episcopal Migration Ministries (EMM) is the refugee resettlement and welcome ministry of the Episcopal Church.

feeds.title: The Episcopal Diocese of Dallas » Bishops' Blog
feeds.description: The Episcopal Diocese of Dallas is a diocese of the Episcopal Church USA which was formed on December 20, 1895.

feeds.title: The Episcopal Church of the Holy Communion
feeds.description: The Episcopal Church of the Holy Communion is a welcoming and diverse community seeking to walk in the way of Jesus and to reveal Christ's reconciling love in our city, nation, and world.

feeds.title: Christ Episcopal Church
feeds.description: The Sunday sermon by the Rev. Diana Wilcox, Rector of Christ Church in Bloomfield & Glen Ridge, NJ, an inclusive Episcopal faith community.

feeds.title: St. Thomas' Episcopal Church
feeds.description: St. Thomas Episcopal church is a community of faith bound together by God's love and seeking His grace to do his will in our lives.

feeds.description: Episcopal Sermons by the Rev. Dr. K .

feeds.title: Episcopal Diocese of Maine Blog
feeds.description: Strengthening communities of faith for God's mission in 57 congregations and ministries across Maine. Follow the Episcopal Diocese of Maine Blog and Stay up-to-date with the latest updates, stories, and news from around the Diocese of Maine.

feeds.title: Episcopal Diocese of Los Angeles Blog
feeds.description: Thoughts and reflections from Bishop John Harvey Taylor on reconciliation, empathy, and spiritual leadership—offering prayers, reflections, and pastoral insights to guide and nurture the Episcopal Diocese of Los Angeles.

feeds.title: TransEpiscopal Blog
feeds.description: The TransEpiscopal community mourns the loss and celebrates the life and witness of our longtime friend and Steering Committee member the Rev. Dr. Victoria (Vicki) Gray. Vicki passed into God's...

feeds.title: The Living Church » Episcopal Church
feeds.description: The Living Church Foundation, Inc., is an independent, not-for-profit foundation of communion-minded and -committed Anglicans from several nations, devoted to seeking and serving the full visible unity of the One, Holy, Catholic, and Apostolic Church.

feeds.title: Episcopal Church of New Hampshire Blog
feeds.description: News, information, messages from Bishop Rob, and more about the Episcopal Church of New Hampshire. Discover practical ways to observe Lent, engage in meaningful reflection, and draw closer to God and one another during this holy season.

feeds.title: Saint Anna's Episcopal Church New Orleans Blog
feeds.description: Spiritual reflections, community updates, and outreach stories from the rector of St. Anna's Episcopal Church in New Orleans.

feeds.title: The Table Indy Blog
feeds.description: The Table is a new church community in the Indianapolis area. We envision a multiplying movement of Jesus communities networked together under the common mission of encountering, embodying, and extending the reconciling love of God in Christ in neighborhoods all over Indy.

feeds.title: St. David's Episcopal Church Blog
feeds.description: St. David's Episcopal Church blog shares heartfelt reflections, spiritual teachings, and community updates that weave together hospitality, faith, outreach, and seasonal observances.

feeds.title: Trinity Episcopal Church Escondido Blog
feeds.description: A thoughtful space of reflections and faith-inspired writing rooted in Episcopal teachings, offering personal and spiritual insights from the life of Trinity Episcopal Church in Escondido.

feeds.title: St Paul's Episcopal Church Blog
feeds.description: St. Paul's Episcopal Church in Mishawaka, Indiana, publishes a blog of thoughtful, faith-centered reflections—written mostly by Fr. Nate—that explore Scripture, tradition, and Christian life within a welcoming church community dedicated to spiritual education and formation.

feeds.title: Virtue Online News
feeds.description: Virtue Online's News section delivers exclusive news and analysis for orthodox Anglicans worldwide, founded in 1995 and now reaching nearly 4 million readers across 204 countries.

feeds.title: Episcopal Church in Connecticut Blog
feeds.description: The blog/site shares news, stories, and updates about what the Episcopal Church is doing around Connecticut, things like events, leadership changes, and special services.

feeds.title: Trinity Episcopal School Blog
feeds.description: Trinity Episcopal School's blog highlights student experiences, school milestones, and community values—from an advocacy-focused 8th-grade trip to Washington, D.C., to reflections on spirituality, diversity, and campus life at the K 8 Episcopal school in uptown Charlotte.

feeds.title: As the Waters Cover the Sea....
feeds.description: I am Ronald, a Deacon in the Episcopal Diocese of Connecticut, and assigned to St. James Episcopal Church in Poquetanuck, CT. In this blog, I write about the challenges and opportunities of leadership in the church, and about sitting with paradox holding it together in tension.

feeds.title: Episcopal Journal
feeds.description: Episcopal Journal is a monthly publication distributed nationally and internationally that covers the Episcopal Church and stories of interest to Episcopalians. The mission of the Episcopal Journal is to inform, involve and inspire Episcopalians in their daily life. We reflect the vibrant, diverse, global Episcopal Church.

feeds.title: Justin Holcomb
feeds.description: The Episcopal Diocese of Central Florida is comprised of over 30,000 people worshipping in over 80 congregations across 15 counties in Central Florida. We are people bound together in the worship of Our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ and driven to serve and share his Good News in a myriad of ways throughout our neighborhoods and communities.

feeds.title: Three Rivers Episcopal
feeds.description: Thoughts and postings from an Episcopal priest in the Diocese of Pittsburgh.

feeds.title: Epistles and Epiphanies
feeds.description: Epistles and Epiphanies is a blog of St. John the Evangelist Episcopal Church, St. Paul, Minnesota offering theological reflection, devotions, musings, weekly epistles and the occasional epiphany. A welcoming Episcopal Church centered on the radical teaching of Jesus, fed by the tradition & liturgy of Anglicanism, and serving the world in God's name!

feeds.title: Bishop Dan's Blog
feeds.description: Bishop Dan, is bishop of the Episcopal churches in Nevada.

feeds.title: Green Sprouts
feeds.description: I'm Betsy Blake Bennett an Episcopal deacon in the Diocese of Nebraska, where I serve as Archdeacon. The focus of my diaconal ministry is the environment: creation care, environmental justice, and the way we connect with God through God's creation.

feeds.title: St. Brendan's Episcopal Church Blog
feeds.description: St. Brendan's congregation is an active participant in the life of the Episcopal Diocese of Pittsburgh of the Episcopal Church. Our mission is the realization of fullness of life through: Worship of God Service to the world Active concern for each other Education to expand the mind and spirit.

feeds.title: Episcopal Church of the Good Shepherd
feeds.description: Episcopal Church of the Good Shepherd. Our mission is to be a Eucharistic Community which tends and feeds the sheep of Jesus Christ, loving one another as God loves us, reaching out to those in need in our valley, the nation, and the world.

feeds.title: Into the Company of the Blessed
feeds.description: I'm Mark, the rector of Saint Francis Episcopal Church, a vibrant parish in suburban Potomac, Maryland. This blog contains Musings about the spiritual life and the mission of the Church by an Episcopal parish priest.

feeds.title: Grace Episcopal Church
feeds.description: Grace Church is an Episcopal congregation in Gainesville, Georgia centered on worship, formation, and service. The mission of the church is to restore all people to unity with God and each other in Christ.

feeds.title: Episcopal Cafe
feeds.description: The Episcopal Café seeks to be an independent voice, reporting and reflecting on the Episcopal Church and the Anglican tradition. The Cafe aims to be a visually appealing, intellectually stimulating, spiritually enriching and at least occasionally amusing website where Episcopalians and those interested in our church can read, watch, listen and reflect upon life and faith.

feeds.title: Episcopal Church in Connecticut » News
feeds.description: The Episcopal Church in Connecticut is part of that - you might say that we are the Connecticut Episcopal branch of the Jesus movement. The Episcopal Church in Connecticut ('ECCT') is the collective witness of its 168 parishes and worshiping communities across the state. We believe that in our Baptism, we are co-missioned to participate in God's mission of restoring and reconciling the world.

feeds.title: Episcopal Diocese of New York
feeds.description: The Episcopal Diocese of New York includes 199 local congregations with about 66,000 members.

feeds.title: Episcopal Diocese of Fort Worth
feeds.description: The Episcopal Diocese of Fort Worth, and the entire Episcopal Church, welcomes you in the name of Jesus Christ. We are a welcoming and affirming group of local Christian communities in and around the Fort Worth area who are united with The Episcopal Church, a province of the worldwide Anglican Communion, and a part of the one, holy, catholic, and apostolic Church.

feeds.title: The Episcopal Diocese of Louisiana
feeds.description: The Diocese of Louisiana is, by grace, a vital community, reborn in the wake of tragedy, forging a new and prophetic environment of healing, trust and empowerment as servants of Jesus Christ. The Diocese of Louisiana is one church, faithful to our Lord Jesus, united in mission, reaching out through service and proclamation to all for whom Christ died.
